review.label: NON_EQUIVALENT
review.rationale: The mutation replaces the condition `if commitment.profile_id != scope.profile.id:` with `if False:`, which unconditionally disables the scope ownership check. In the original code, when a commitment's profile_id does not match the scope's profile id, a `GlhsInvariantError` is raised with the message 'commitment_scope_forbidden'. After the mutation, this check never executes regardless of the input values. Any caller passing a commitment belonging to a different profile than the scope will no longer receive the error — the function will proceed past this guard. This produces an observable behavioral difference: the governed system will accept cross-profile commitment transitions that would previously have been rejected with an exception.
